standard_prerequisites.name: The identification of the diagonal of a base change with a base change of the diagonal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 5996-6000)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces every separation property to a property of the diagonal.

standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion for checking a property of a representable morphism after a surjective flat finitely presented base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 6001-6015)
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the properties of the diagonal between the morphism and its base change.

standard_prerequisites.name: The definitions of the separation properties through the diagonal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 6016-6030)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the diagonal properties back into the separation properties.

core_obligations: Reduce to the diagonal: the diagonal of the base change is the base change of the diagonal, so it suffices to compare the corresponding properties of the two diagonals (proof lines 5995-6005)

Apply the covering criterion: the base change morphism is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, so the criterion for representable morphisms applies and each of the diagonal properties holds for the original exactly when it holds for the base change (proof lines 6006-6020)
Return to the morphisms: by the definitions of the separation properties in terms of the diagonal, the same equivalence holds for the properties themselves (proof lines 6021-6036)
proof_roadmap: Δ_{f'} 是 Δ_f 的基变换 ⇒ 只需比较 Δ 的性质。
基变换态射满、平坦、局部有限表现 ⇒ 用「可表示态射的性质沿覆盖检验」的判据。
按各项分离性质对 Δ 的定义回到态射本身，得结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the separation properties of a morphism of algebraic stacks hold if and only if they hold for its base change along a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 5985-5993, label lemma-check-separated-on-ui-cover). The proof (source lines 5995-6037) reduces to the diagonal through the base change formula, applies the covering criterion for properties of representable morphisms and reads the separation properties back off the diagonal (proof lines 5995-6036). The reduction and the application of the covering criterion are the substance. H3.
